dashboard.label: Snowflake Security Data Lake
dashboard.description: Security analytics with compute offloaded to Snowflake (DB Connect federated search)

search.query: | dbxquery connection="snowflake" query="SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL FROM CTF.PUBLIC.ACCESS_LOGS"
| dbxquery connection="snowflake" query="SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM CTF.PUBLIC.ACCESS_LOGS WHERE STATUS_CODE = 401"
| dbxquery connection="snowflake" query="SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM CTF.PUBLIC.ACCESS_LOGS WHERE STATUS_CODE >= 500"
| dbxquery connection="snowflake" query="SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM CTF.PUBLIC.VULNERABILITIES WHERE STATUS = 'OPEN'"
| dbxquery connection="snowflake" query="SELECT REQUEST_METHOD, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM CTF.PUBLIC.ACCESS_LOGS GROUP BY REQUEST_METHOD ORDER BY COUNT DESC"
| dbxquery connection="snowflake" query="SELECT CAST(STATUS_CODE AS VARCHAR) AS STATUS_CODE, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM CTF.PUBLIC.ACCESS_LOGS GROUP BY STATUS_CODE ORDER BY COUNT DESC"

panel.title: Endpoint Risk Assessment (CTE — runs entirely on Snowflake)

search.query: | dbxquery connection="snowflake" query="WITH path_analysis AS (SELECT SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(REQUEST_PATH, '/', 2), '/', 1) AS ENDPOINT, COUNT(*) AS REQUESTS, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CODE = 401 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AUTH_FAILURES, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CODE >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS ERROR_RATE_PCT FROM CTF.PUBLIC.ACCESS_LOGS GROUP BY 1) SELECT ENDPOINT, REQUESTS, AUTH_FAILURES, ERROR_RATE_PCT, CASE WHEN AUTH_FAILURES > 1000 THEN 'HIGH_RISK' WHEN AUTH_FAILURES > 500 THEN 'MEDIUM_RISK' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS RISK FROM path_analysis ORDER BY REQUESTS DESC"

| dbxquery connection="snowflake" query="SELECT CASE WHEN SEVERITY >= 9 THEN 'Critical' WHEN SEVERITY >= 7 THEN 'High' WHEN SEVERITY >= 4 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS SEVERITY_LEVEL, STATUS, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM CTF.PUBLIC.VULNERABILITIES GROUP BY SEVERITY_LEVEL, STATUS ORDER BY COUNT DESC"

panel.title: Top 10 Backend Servers by Error Rate

search.query: | dbxquery connection="snowflake" query="SELECT BACKEND_IP, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_HITS, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CODE >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SERVER_ERRORS, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CODE >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS ERROR_RATE_PCT FROM CTF.PUBLIC.ACCESS_LOGS GROUP BY BACKEND_IP HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY SERVER_ERRORS DESC LIMIT 10"
| dbxquery connection="snowflake" query="SELECT FINDING_TYPE, SEVERITY, STATUS, IP_ADDRESS, DESCRIPTION, DETECTED_AT FROM CTF.PUBLIC.SECURITY_FINDINGS ORDER BY DETECTED_AT DESC LIMIT 25"

| dbxquery connection="snowflake" query="WITH stats AS (SELECT IP_ADDRESS, COUNT(*) AS REQUESTS, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER() AS AVG_REQUESTS, STDDEV(COUNT(*)) OVER() AS STDDEV_REQUESTS FROM CTF.PUBLIC.ACCESS_LOGS GROUP BY IP_ADDRESS) SELECT IP_ADDRESS, REQUESTS, ROUND((REQUESTS - AVG_REQUESTS) / NULLIF(STDDEV_REQUESTS, 0), 2) AS Z_SCORE FROM stats WHERE ABS((REQUESTS - AVG_REQUESTS) / NULLIF(STDDEV_REQUESTS, 0)) > 2 ORDER BY Z_SCORE DESC LIMIT 20"
